DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 星を見る会の受付ですね。お持ち物を確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is registration for the stargazing event. May I check what you have brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ライトを持ってきました。暗い中を歩くためですが、観察中も点けてよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 観察会で持参ライトの使用を先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've brought a light for walking in the dark, but I'd like to check whether I can also turn it on during observation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese beforehand about using the light you brought to the observation event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会の担当から点灯の案内があります。人の顔へ向けないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The event organizer will give instructions about turning on lights. Please do not point them at people's faces.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人が望遠鏡をのぞいている所を照らそうと思いましたが、先に聞いてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 望遠鏡使用者の顔を照らさず案内を受けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I was thinking of lighting up my friend while they looked through the telescope, so I'm glad I asked first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will follow instructions without shining the light at the face of someone using a telescope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 移動の時と観察の時は、担当の案内に合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please follow the organizer's instructions both when moving and when observing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このライトは明るさを変えられます。自分で消して歩くのも不安なので、使える明るさを担当に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明るさ調節できる灯具を担当に確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: This light has adjustable brightness. I'm also worried about walking with it off on my own judgment, so I'd like the organizer to check what brightness I can use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the organizer in Japanese to check the light with adjustable brightness.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へお見せください。受付付近なら、足元を確認して待てます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show it to the organizer. You can check your footing and wait near registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。暗い芝生へ勝手に移動せず、案内された道から観察場所へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付で待ち芝生へ勝手に移動しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait here. I won't go onto the dark lawn on my own; I'll use the indicated path to the observation area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will wait at registration and will not go onto the lawn on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終わった後の戻り方も、こちらでご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will also explain how to get back afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。帰りの道を確認してから参加し、友人にもライトは顔へ向けないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰路を確認し友人にもライト配慮を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll check the way back before taking part and tell my friend not to point lights at faces either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check the return route and tell your friend to use the light considerately too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当の案内をお待ちください。今夜の観察をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23226-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait for the organizer's instructions, then. Enjoy tonight's observation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble at the ticket gate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 入る時に使った切符が見つかりません。財布の中だと思っていたのですが、出す場所を忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入場時に使った乗車券を見失ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't find the ticket I used to enter. I thought it was in my wallet, but I've forgotten where I put it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have lost track of the train ticket you used to enter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの端で、荷物を落ち着いてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check your belongings calmly over here at the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通路を空けて探します。財布だけでなく、上着のポケットも見てみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路を空け財布と上着を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll leave the passage clear while I look. I'll check my jacket pockets as well as my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will leave the passage clear and search your wallet and jacket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お連れの方が、切符をお持ちではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could someone traveling with you have your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人で来ました。探しているのは私の切符一枚です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 単独移動で本人一枚のみと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I came alone. I'm looking for just my one ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clarify in Japanese that you are traveling alone and looking for only your own one ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 見つからなければ、乗車した駅などを伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you can't find it, we'll ask which station you boarded at and other details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありました。財布の札入れの奥へ入れていました。定期券ではなく、この紙の切符です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 札入奥から今日の紙券発見を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've found it. I'd put it at the back of the banknote compartment in my wallet. It's this paper ticket, not a commuter pass.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you found today's paper ticket at the back of the banknote compartment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、切符をこちらで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the ticket here, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日使ったこの一枚です。こちらで確認をお願いします。荷物を戻してから改札を出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見つけた当日の券の確認を頼み荷物整理後に改札を出ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's this one ticket I used today. Please check it here. I'll put my belongings back before leaving through the gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the found ticket from today to be checked and say you will leave the gate after organizing your belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認できました。こちらからお進みください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've checked it. Please go through here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 防災講座のお申し込みでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to sign up for the disaster preparedness class?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 関心がありますが、日本語の長い説明を聞くのが苦手です。写真や実物も使う講座ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 防災講座の写真実物使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm interested, but I find it difficult to listen to long explanations in Japanese. Does the class also use photographs and actual objects?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the disaster preparedness class uses photographs and actual objects.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当の案内では、写真と防災用品を使う予定です。文章だけの説明ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: According to the organizer, they plan to use photographs and disaster preparedness supplies. The explanations are not text alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それなら参加してみたいです。分からない言葉をメモして、後で調べるつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 参加希望と不明語メモを述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: In that case, I'd like to try taking part. I'll note unfamiliar words and look them up later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to participate and will note unfamiliar words.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 資料をお渡しします。読めない箇所は当日の担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here are the materials. Please ask the organizer on the day about any parts you cannot read.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 事前にもらえると助かります。全部読めなくても、持ち物のページを先に見ておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 事前資料の持物ページを読むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It helps to receive them in advance. Even if I can't read everything, I'll look at the page on things to bring first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will read the page on things to bring in the advance materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当日は筆記具をお持ちください。お申し込みも承りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please bring writing materials on the day. Would you like us to register you too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、申し込みます。写真と実物を見ながら学べると聞いて、参加してみたいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: この講座へ申込むと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please register me. Hearing that I can learn with photographs and actual objects made me want to try participating.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clearly state in Japanese that you are signing up for this class.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらへお名前と連絡先をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please write your name and contact details here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記入しました。資料は家で読んで、質問したい言葉を別の紙へ控えて持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料予習と質問語持参を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've filled it in. I'll read the materials at home, note the words I want to ask about on a separate sheet, and bring it along.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will study the materials beforehand and bring words to ask about.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お申し込みを受け付けました。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your registration has been accepted. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 待合で水をこぼしました。椅子の下まで濡れています。滑ると危ないので知らせに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: こぼした水による床濡れを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I spilled water in the waiting area. It's wet even under the chairs. I came to tell you because someone could slip and get hurt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that spilled water has made the floor wet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: おけがはありませんか。場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you hurt? Please tell me where it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私はけがをしていません。入口から二列目の椅子で、水のボトルを倒しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人にけがはなく二列目の椅子でボトルを倒したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm not hurt. I knocked over a water bottle at the chairs in the second row from the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are not hurt and knocked over the bottle at the second row of chairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 職員を呼びます。濡れた所へは戻らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll call a staff member. Please don't go back onto the wet area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ床へ手を付いて拭いてはいません。持っていたティッシュだけでは足りないと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 独力清掃せず知らせたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't put my hands on the floor to wipe it yet. I thought the tissues I had wouldn't be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you came to report it without trying to clean it alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身のお荷物が、濡れた場所に残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are any of your belongings still in the wet area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かばんは椅子の上にあります。床には置いていませんが、取りに行く時は職員の案内を受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 椅子上かばん回収への案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My bag is on a chair. I didn't put it on the floor, but I'd like staff guidance when going to retrieve it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for guidance on retrieving your bag from the chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらでかばんをお持ちします。隣の待合でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll bring your bag. Please wait in the neighboring waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。飲み物はふたを閉めました。ほかの方が通る前に対応していただき、ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: かばん受取とボトル閉栓を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received it. I've closed the lid on my drink. Thank you for dealing with this before other people pass through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you received your bag and closed the bottle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 清掃担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll hand this over to the cleaning staff. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 巡回について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you contacting us about patrols?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の近くの通学路で、夕方に車が速く走るのを見掛けます。下校中の子どもがいるので、様子を見てもらえないか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通学路の速い車を見て巡回可否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I see cars driving fast in the evening on a school route near my home. There are children going home from school, so I'd like to ask whether someone could check the situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you saw fast cars on a school route and want to ask whether patrols are possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所と、気付かれた時間帯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the location and the time of day you noticed it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小学校の南の交差点です。午後四時ごろに、下校する子どもが歩いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 南交差点四時下校児の位置時刻を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's the intersection south of the elementary school. Around four in the afternoon, children were walking home from school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the location and time in Japanese: the southern intersection, four o'clock, and children going home from school.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車の速度を、ご自身で測ったということではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You haven't measured the cars' speed yourself, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 速度は測っていません。ただ、子どもが渡ろうとしているそばを速く通ったように見えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 速度は未測定だが児童の横を速く通ったように見えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't measured it. But it looked as though a car passed quickly beside children who were trying to cross.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you did not measure the speed, but it appeared to pass quickly beside the children.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へお伝えします。巡回の時刻や実施を、今ここでお約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass your request to the person in charge. We cannot promise here and now whether or when a patrol will take place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。見た場所と時間帯を記録して、担当の方へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 巡回の確約がないことを理解し観察場所時間帯の担当共有を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Please record where and when I saw it and tell the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you understand no patrol is guaranteed and ask for the observed location and time to be shared with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかに気付いた点はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 交差点の角に配送の車が止まっていて、子どもの姿が見えにくい時もありました。そのことも合わせてお伝えしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 角の配送車で児童が見えにくいことを追加して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: A delivery vehicle was stopped at the intersection corner, and at times it made the children hard to see. I'd like to mention that as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Add in Japanese that a delivery vehicle at the corner made the children hard to see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所と状況を担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass the location and circumstances to the person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お送りになる中身を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell me what you are sending?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社から預かった箱です。封をした後で渡されたので、中に何があるか正確には知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社から預かった封箱の内容を正確に知らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a box entrusted to me by my company. It was handed to me after it was sealed, so I don't know exactly what's inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you do not know the exact contents of the sealed box entrusted to you by your company.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中身の種類を確認してから、受付をご案内します。会社の担当へ尋ねられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll explain acceptance after checking the types of contents. Can you ask the person in charge at your company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 担当へ電話できます。見た目が小さいから書類だけ、と私が決めて答えるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社担当へ電話し外観から書類のみと推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can call them. I won't decide and answer that it's just documents because it looks small.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will call the company contact and will not infer from its appearance that it contains only documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、ご確認ください。箱を勝手に開けて調べる必要は今ありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check, then. There is no need to open the box without permission to inspect it now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここでは開けません。電話で聞いたら、書類と布の見本が入っているそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己開封せず担当の書類と布見本の回答を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't open it here. I called and was told it contains documents and fabric samples.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you did not open it yourself and relay the contact's answer of documents and fabric samples.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類と布の見本ですね。ほかに含まれている物は確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Documents and fabric samples, then. Have you checked whether anything else is included?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 担当は、その二種類だけと言っています。会社から聞いた内容として伝えます。私が全部を見たという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二種類だけとの伝聞と本人確認済を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The contact says those are the only two types. I'm relaying what the company told me, not saying I saw everything myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese between being told there are only two types and personally checking them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その情報で、送り方と条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll use that information to check shipping methods and conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。まだ受付済みではないので、会社にも確認中と伝えます。発送した後で、控えを持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未受付確認中を会社へ伝え発送後控え持帰を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. It hasn't been accepted yet, so I'll also tell my company it's still being checked. I'll take the receipt back after shipping it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will tell the company acceptance is still under review and take the receipt back after shipping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、中身と宛先を確認します。それでは、こちらへどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check the contents and destination, then. Please come this way. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振り込みについてのご確認ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking a bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社は給料を振り込んだと言っていますが、私の記録にはありません。振込先の紙を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与入金未確認と振込先紙の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company says it transferred my salary, but it isn't in my records. Could you look at the sheet with the transfer account details?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the salary deposit is unconfirmed and ask for the transfer-details sheet to be checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の通帳と、その紙の銀行名をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the bank name on your bankbook and on that sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この通帳とは銀行名が違います。以前使っていた別の銀行が紙に残っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 異なる旧銀行名に気付いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bank name is different from this bankbook. The sheet still had a different bank I used before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you noticed the different former bank name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その別の銀行の口座へ入っているかは、こちらでは確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot check here whether it was deposited in your account at that other bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 古い口座もまだ私の物です。そちらの記録を確認してから、会社へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧本人口座の記録確認を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The old account is still mine too. I'll check its records before telling my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to check the records of your old account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今お持ちの資料は、ご本人へお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll return the documents you brought to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受け取りました。会社へ「未払い」と言う前に、紙に書かれた振込先を確認する必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未払断定前に振込先確認を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've received them. Before telling my company it is unpaid, I need to check the transfer destination written on the sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check the transfer destination before concluding it is unpaid.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた内容を、会社の担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss what you have confirmed with your company's contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。次回の振込先の変更も会社へ頼みますが、今回の入金先の確認とは分けて話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回確認と次回振込先変更を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I'll also ask the company to change the account for the next transfer, but discuss that separately from checking where this payment went.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese between checking this payment and changing the account for the next transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 必要な資料をお持ち帰りください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your necessary documents home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ポイントのご利用についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about using points?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯でアプリを使っていません。紙のカードがあれば使いたいのですが、こちらでは作れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: アプリ以外の紙カード発行を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't use the app on my phone. I'd like to use a paper card if there is one. Can I get one here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about issuing a paper card instead of using the app.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この店では、紙のカードもご用意しています。お名前の登録が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This store also has paper cards. Registering your name is required.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙でも登録するのですね。名前を書く場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙カードの氏名登録欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So registration is needed even for paper cards. Please show me where to write my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese where to register your name for the paper card.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この申込書へお書きください。カード発行の条件もこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write it on this application form. The card issuance conditions are here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 条件を読んでから申し込みます。まだ会計の前なので、今日は無理に急がず確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 条件を読んでから申込むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll read the conditions before applying. I haven't paid yet, so I'd like to check without rushing unnecessarily today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will read the conditions before applying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: レジの列を空けて、サービス窓口でご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can leave the checkout line clear and read them at the service counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そちらへ移ります。カードがまだない間の買い物は、通常の会計でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口へ移り当面通常会計を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll move there. While I don't have a card yet, please process my shopping through the normal checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will move to the counter and want normal checkout for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本日のお買い物に後でポイントを付けられるかは、サービス担当へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the service staff whether points can be added to today's shopping afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 付くと決め付けず担当へ聞きます。まず条件を読んで、自分が使えるカードか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 後付ポイントを断定せず条件相談を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask the staff without assuming they can be added. First I'll read the conditions and check whether it is a card I can use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not assume points can be added afterward and will ask about the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: サービス窓口は向こうです。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The service counter is over there. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花壇の活動にご興味がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you interested in the flowerbed activities?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。手伝ってみたいですが、道具を持っていません。初心者でも参加できる回はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 道具なし初心者の参加可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like to try helping, but I don't have tools. Are there any sessions beginners can join?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether a beginner without tools can participate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 来週の回は初めての方も参加できます。道具は担当が用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First-time participants can join next week's session too. The organizer will provide tools.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 道具がなくてもよいのですね。自分で花を植えるより、まず教わりながら手伝いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 教わりながらの参加希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it's all right not to have tools. Rather than planting flowers on my own, I'd like to help while learning first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to participate while receiving instruction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 参加者には、水やりや片付けをお願いする予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We plan to ask participants to water and tidy up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水やりから始められると助かります。どの花にどれだけ必要か、担当の説明を聞いてから作業します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水やりは担当説明後に行うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It would help to start with watering. I'll listen to the organizer explain which flowers need how much water before working.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will water after the organizer's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 汚れてもよい服と靴でお越しください。手袋はご自身でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please come in clothes and shoes you don't mind getting dirty. Please provide your own gloves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手袋だけは用意します。服も作業用にします。雨の日も同じ時間に来ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作業服手袋準備と雨天予定を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll provide the gloves myself, then. I'll wear work clothes too. Should I come at the same time on rainy days?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will prepare work clothes and gloves, and ask about rainy-day plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 雨天時の実施は、前日に受付へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check with registration the day before whether it will go ahead in rain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 前日に受付へ聞いてから来ます。今日は参加の連絡先を控えて、手袋を準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 前日受付確認と必要品準備を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask registration the day before coming. Today I'll note the participation contact details and prepare gloves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check with registration the day before and prepare what you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 初参加のご希望を伺いました。それでは、またお待ちしております。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23227-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've noted that you would like to join for the first time. We look forward to seeing you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車が到着します。お荷物はおそろいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The train is arriving. Do you have all your belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。弁当の袋をベンチへ置いたままです。取ってから乗りたいですが、無理にこの列車へ走り込むのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベンチ弁当を取るが走込乗車しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry, I left my lunch bag on the bench. I'd like to get it before boarding, but I won't rush to force my way onto this train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will retrieve your lunch from the bench but will not run to board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 安全にお取りください。扉が閉まる際は、無理なご乗車をしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please retrieve it safely. Do not force your way on when the doors are closing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: すぐそこに見えます。空いている側から歩いて取ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋の位置を示し空いている側から取りに行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can see it right there. I'll walk around the clear side to get it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the bag's location and explain in Japanese that you will approach from the clear side to retrieve it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかにベンチへ置いた物はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you left anything else on the bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水のボトルも置いていました。袋の横にあるので、一緒に取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 置き忘れたボトルも一緒に回収すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also left my water bottle. It's beside the bag, so I'll retrieve them together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will also retrieve the forgotten bottle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身のお荷物をお確かめください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つともそろいました。列車の扉はもう閉まりそうなので、この列車は見送って次を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物そろえて閉扉列車を見送ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've got both. The train doors are about to close, so I'll let this train go and wait for the next one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to gather your belongings and let the train with closing doors go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の列車の案内を、表示でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the display for information about the next train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 次の列車を表示で確認します。友人には一本後の列車になると連絡しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次列車を確認し友人へ一便遅れると連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the next train on the display. I'll let my friend know I'll be on the train one service later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check the next train and tell your friend you will be one train later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ安全にお待ちください。それでは、お気をつけて。
